# Hoehne Property Maintenance & Remodeling — AI Overview

## Who We Are
Hoehne Property Maintenance & Remodeling LLC is a veteran-owned home services company based in Pottstown, Pennsylvania. Founded by Aaron Hoehne, a U.S. Military veteran with over 20 years of hands-on construction and property maintenance experience.

## What We Do
We handle everything from small handyman repairs to full home renovations for homeowners in Pottstown, Boyertown, Phoenixville, Limerick, Collegeville, Royersford, and surrounding areas in Montgomery and Chester Counties, PA.

### Services
- **Home Remodeling** — kitchens, bathrooms, basements, full renovations
- **Handyman Services** — repairs, drywall, doors, fixtures, carpentry
- **Interior & Exterior Painting** — walls, trim, siding, decks
- **Lawn Care & Landscaping** — mowing, trimming, seasonal maintenance
- **Snow Removal** — residential and commercial driveways and walkways
- **Deck Building & Repair** — new builds, repairs, staining, pressure washing
- **Pressure Washing** — driveways, siding, decks
- **Wallpaper & Specialty Finishes** — murals, custom installs

## Why Choose Hoehne
Aaron Hoehne brings the same discipline, reliability, and attention to detail from his military service to every job. No subcontractors farming out your work. No surprises on the bill. He shows up when he says he will and doesn't leave until the job is done right.
